shots.x: A painted wall in the temple of Ambikā: a mountain, a serpent, a dark flood, a hand at a god's throat, and a goddess walking a line of suitors. A priest sweeps at the far end.
Rukmini's face, lit by nothing but the light off the painted wall. The first time the film looks at her.
Her finger touches the painted figure at the end of the line — the one the goddess stopped for.
